curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8848-1/ (scans; the truck is pages 1 and 3-12: tipper body and bucket on pages 1 and 3, chassis steps 1-28 on pages 4-12; alternate models after, motorising photos on pages 21-23)

functions.does: The steering wheel on top of the cab turns the front wheels: its column's bevel gear turns a shaft with an 8 tooth gear that drives a rack on a tie plate between the two steering arms.
functions.source: book: steps 9-11 (rack and tie plate), 14-16 (pinion shaft) and 19 (column and wheel)

functions.does: The rear axle has a differential, so as it rolls round a bend each rear wheel can turn at its own speed.
As it rolls, the differential's big gear also turns two bevel gears: one on a drive shaft running forward under the cab through a universal joint, one on a short axle sticking out at the back.
functions.source: book: steps 7-8; what the shafts are for is inferred (the motorising photos on pages 21-23 drive the truck through one of them)
functions.note: unsure what the forward shaft drives in the unmotorised truck

functions.does: The yellow lever on the right of the steering wheel tips the body: a link from it turns a 24 tooth gear like a crank, whose axle's other 24 tooth gear turns the 8 tooth gears on the cross axle under the body, and they push two racks that lift the body on struts about its hinge at the back.
functions.source: book: steps 12-13 (racks and struts), 17-18 (the 24 tooth gears and link), 20-21 and 24; what the lever does is inferred

functions.does: The yellow lever on the left of the steering wheel raises and lowers the front bucket's arms through a linkage of toggle joints and axles running forward under the cab.
functions.source: inferred: book steps 21-22 and 28 show the lever, the linkage and the bucket's arms, but no arrows; unsure how the linkage meets the arms

functions.does: The 24 tooth gear at the front of the cab, behind the bucket, tips the bucket: turned as a knob, it swings a stick on a toggle joint that pushes the bucket's upright yellow arm, tilting the bucket on its axle at the arms' ends.
functions.source: inferred: book step 21 (the gear, toggle joint and stick) and step 28 (the bucket and its arm); unsure the gear is meant as a knob rather than a ratchet

functions.does: Pushed along, the front wheels roll freely on their stub axles in the steering arms.

questions.question: What does each yellow lever do? Is the front 24 tooth gear a knob or a ratchet? What does the forward drive shaft drive without a motor?
